overview:
GW9 brought a big shake-up in the chasing pack, with one manager making a serious move! Mcginning to believe stays top with a superb 80 points this week, taking the overall total to 653. But MattyCashInTheAttic was right on their heels with an excellent 76-point haul, climbing from 3rd to 2nd and moving ahead of DuncanDisorder, who drops to 3rd after scoring 43. The gap at the summit is now 23 points, with plenty of time for that to change. Brian the lion was the biggest climber, jumping three places from 16th to 13th after a strong 65 points, while Gayfield of Dreams also made good progress, moving up two spots to 4th. At the other end of the top ten, Krusty's Blue Moon had a week to forget, slipping three places from 4th to 7th. There were also solid returns from Delap of the Gods with 67 and Mcginniesta with 66, although neither moved up the table. The battle for the top spots is certainly heating up!

In the Premier League, GW9 was a week of clean sheets, surprise results and some painful captaincy returns. There were 21 goals across the ten matches, with seven teams keeping a clean sheet. The biggest FPL talking point was Erling Haaland, who was the most-captained player but managed just 2 points as Manchester City lost 1-0 at home to Brighton. Arsenal also claimed a huge 1-0 win at Liverpool, while Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0, with United reduced to ten men. Spurs continued their good run with a 2-0 victory over Crystal Palace, and Everton nicked a 1-0 win away at Newcastle. Elsewhere, Bournemouth and Brentford both recorded 2-0 wins, while Hull and Ipswich shared four goals in a 2-2 draw. With Haaland blanking and defenders doing plenty of the damage, it was a week when a well-picked back line could make all the difference!
